$comment: Copy to config.json and edit. config.json is gitignored, so your local tweaks stay yours. Anything you omit falls back to these defaults.

display.$comment: How to pick which monitor the HUD lands on. strategy: 'bounds' matches the monitor whose top-left corner is at bounds.x/bounds.y; 'smallest' picks the lowest-resolution monitor; 'index' uses the Nth monitor as Electron enumerates them; 'primary' uses the main one. If the chosen strategy finds nothing, 'fallback' is tried.

window.$comment: clickThrough makes the HUD ignore the mouse entirely — clicks pass through to whatever is underneath, so you can never accidentally focus or drag it. Turn it off if you want the interactive panel-cycling clicks.

polling.$comment: fastMs drives load/temp/clock/network. slowMs drives things that barely change (disk capacity, uptime, process count).

nvidiaSmi.$comment: NVIDIA GPU telemetry. Works without admin. Set path if nvidia-smi.exe is not on PATH.

libreHardwareMonitor.$comment: OPTIONAL. Unlocks AMD CPU package temp, CPU power draw, fan RPM and motherboard sensors, which Windows will not report on its own. Install LibreHardwareMonitor, enable Options > Remote Web Server > Run, and run it as Administrator. The HUD works fine without it — those fields just read '--'.

network.$comment: Leave interface null to auto-pick the busiest non-loopback adapter.

thresholds.$comment: Drives the colour shift from cyan through amber to magenta. Celsius, percent, watts.

power.$comment: Holds off the display-sleep timer so the HUD monitor stays lit and Windows never reshuffles your windows off it.
